argument: Eight open routes must read as one interlocked typographic body before they read as separate decorative loops. The dark throat, oblique rim, unequal scales, and mouth hierarchy must carry the image without interface chrome.

With readout, controls, note, hint, register, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v039's route sheet, v040's pressure rack, and v041's negative syntax. It should read as a joined body with load-bearing openings, not a type specimen or route diagram.

The visitor must connect two structural mouths, not click a glyph or wait at a chamber. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the bind control must expose the same meaningful relation without a hover-only requirement.

A pending connection must remain geometry-neutral. Completion must produce actual remote path structure, width, bend, angle, and hinge notch; cursor trails, colour, status, and prose cannot substitute for the geometry.
Both touched mouths and their owning routes must stay exact. The consequence must arrive at two untouched routes, proving that the join is displaced rather than painted at the hand.
Reversing the mouth order must change the polarity of the produced fusion. If direction only changes a label or hue, the hinge rule is false.
Four remote fusions must compound in one body. Delete must reconstruct the exact preceding path field and release must restore the deterministic quiet seed.

Generated SVG Bézier routes, secondary fusion paths, structural mouths, and persistent route state are the medium. No screenshot, imported type specimen, external font, or CSS poster may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from material behaviour that participates in geometry production into a non-local join law. Brush presets, watercolor, hatching, grain, palette, composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.

v042 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal behaviour, shape vocabulary, and viewer task: negative gaps, held chambers, and junction reading become a monolithic SVG body whose ephemeral join alters untouched route topology.

Delete v042 if the blind body is a generic loop diagram, if an incomplete or repeated pair commits, if touched mouths deform, if remote fusion is cosmetic, if all pairings coincide, if later fusions reset, or if lifting is inexact.
